text: [angry, fast] Not a true reflection? We had one shot on target. One!
Scotland lose four-nil in Switzerland and miss the play-offs. One question. Pocognoli... give him time, or change now?
[passionate, raised voice] It's six games! Give the man time. We were decent in the first half.
[laughing in disbelief] Two wins, both against North Macedonia. Ha! My granny's five-a-side team has a better record.
[tired, quiet] Clarke's teams fought for you. [sighs] This lot fall apart the minute we go behind.
[calm, firm] Neither. Two goals in four minutes after the break? That's on the players.
Think you'd pick a better team for March? On ACTXION, Starting 11 sends your XI to Scotland and the manager.
Give him time, or change now? You tell us.
